parameters.query:
=SELECT true AS ok,
  j.id::text AS job_id,
  j.status::text AS status,
  j.project_name,
  j.drive_root_folder_id,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM content_tasks t WHERE t.job_id=j.id AND t.status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')) AS active_task_count,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM content_outputs o WHERE o.job_id=j.id) AS output_count,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM content_errors e WHERE e.job_id=j.id AND e.resolved_at IS NULL) AS open_error_count
FROM content_jobs j
WHERE j.id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid;
